text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки stuns the audience at the
Yayoi Sho,
and expectations for her to
claim the Classic
Triple Crown rise even
higher.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She begins training even harder than
ever to meet
those expectations. I'm
touched by her
dedication and plan a
surprise to reward her hard
work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I want to give her a star, so I attempt
sleight of
hand to conjure a brooch
shaped like the evening
star...
Unfortunately, my trick ends in failure.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Despite my fumbling, Фудзи Кисэки is still
touched
by my gesture. At last, next up
for us is the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
